title: Don't miss out on the opportunity to hike Sierra Nevada
text: This is an amazing opportunity to discover something beyond the traditional city sightseeing in Granada. Julio is a very knowledgeable and friendly guide, he shares interesting stories along the way. And the cherry on top - he makes photos for you to take home. Highly recommended
author: Anna_C

title: Have a taste of Sierra Nevada National Park
text: It was nice to get out of the city and to have a taste of the Sierra Nevada National Park.  We saw mountain goats looking down on us. Walking in canyon was fun.  Julio was great:  he arrived on time for pick up and maintained a good pace for the group.  The first section is a little steep but overall is easy.
author: Drhsiaochingchen

title: A beautiful, fun hiking...
text: A beautiful, fun hiking experience. Our guide, Julio, took us on a route that was quiet and went in a direction that meant we avoided most of the crowds. He shared lots of information, answered our many questions, and took some great photos too. I only wish we could have hiked for longer!
author: Uma_C

title: Very pleasant
text:
Magnificent and very pleasant hike. 
The starting point was very well indicated and convenient if you are staying in the center of Granada. 
Julio is a great guide who tells lots of anecdotes about the region and takes his time on the hike. 
Also accommodating regarding the return point.
author: loannep673

title: Amazing Sierra Nevada hike
text: Very good hike. Excellent guide. Amazing scenery. Pick up was on time. Strongly recommend Julio as a guide.
author: gwgaryw170

title: Unforgettable Hike in the Sierra Nevada!
text:
We had an incredible experience on our English-speaking hike through the Sierra Nevada! The scenery was absolutely stunning, featuring incredible canyon bridges and fascinating caves that made the route truly unique.

Our guide, Marcello, went above and beyond to make the day special. He kept the group informed and comfortable, provided delicious snacks and cold water, and took fantastic photos of us along the way so we could enjoy the experience. Traveling in a small group made the experience feel personal and well-paced.

title: Our new favorite in Spain!!
text: FABULOUS morning hike! Beautiful views, vigorous hike. Not for the faint of heart! This hike has some fairly challenging hill climbs and scrambles, plus narrow ledges to pass in crouched positions or on hands & knees, and fairly steep steps and hills. Don't carry a bag or a child on this hike as you will have great difficulty safely getting thru the narrow passages with anything on your back or front.  Our guide was FANTASTIC!
author: Stephanie_W
